openPresentation.purpose: Open or reuse one exact existing .pptx presentation.
openPresentation.verification: Verify authorized artifact path and existing dirty state.
prerequisites: Explicit existing-file or new-document intent; UNBOUND Task.
constraints: Only ordinary .pptx files; missing files never become creation requests.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

getPresentationInfo.purpose: Read bound presentation size, saved state and its own window.
getPresentationInfo.verification: Compare slide dimensions in points and saved state; a null window does not prove desktop visibility.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Window information comes only from the bound presentation.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

listSlides.purpose: Read ordered slide IDs and a structure observation token.
listSlides.verification: Check ordered IDs and indices; token covers ordered slide summaries.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: At most 200 slides.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

getSlideInfo.purpose: Read top-level shapes, text and aggregate font properties of a slide.
getSlideInfo.verification: Check shape IDs, text and geometry. Mixed font properties are null.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: At most 100 top-level shapes and 10000 UTF-16 units per shape; token covers returned fields, not notes, animations, groups or individual text runs.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

addSlide.purpose: Insert a blank slide at a 1-based position.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest listSlides for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

addSlide.verification: Confirm one new slide at the requested position.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use listSlides token. Position is at most current count + 1; blank layout only.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

duplicateSlide.purpose: Duplicate one slide immediately after itself.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

duplicateSlide.verification: Confirm one new slide after the source and inspect its contents.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token for the source. WPS performs the native duplicate.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

moveSlide.purpose: Move one slide to a 1-based final position.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest listSlides for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

moveSlide.verification: Confirm source ID appears at the requested final index.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use listSlides token; move retains the stable SlideID.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

deleteSlide.verification: Confirm the source ID is absent and remaining order is correct.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token. Deletion includes notes, animations and all slide content; obtain user intent for deleting the whole slide.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

addTextBox.purpose: Add a horizontal text box with literal text and explicit dimensions.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

addTextBox.verification: Confirm one new text box with the requested text and dimensions.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token. Coordinates are points.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

addShape.purpose: Add a rectangle or ellipse at explicit dimensions.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

addShape.verification: Confirm one new shape of the requested kind and dimensions.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token; only two admitted native AutoShape types.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

setShapeText.purpose: Replace all text in one text-capable top-level shape.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

setShapeText.verification: Compare normalized LF text exactly; inspect formatting after full replacement.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token. Full replacement may reset existing rich formatting; no groups, tables, charts or selection.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

formatText.purpose: Apply a uniform font patch to the complete shape text.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

color.description: Encode RGB channels (0-255) as R + G*256 + B*65536 (0xBBGGRR). Example: #1F3864 = 6567967; red #FF0000 = 255. Do not use the ordinary 0xRRGGBB integer.

formatText.verification: Compare every requested aggregate font property with native readback.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token. Latin and East Asian font names are separate properties. Font color is native OLE RGB integer (red + green*256 + blue*65536); formatting covers all text.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

setShapeGeometry.purpose: Move or resize one top-level shape in points.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

setShapeGeometry.verification: Compare requested coordinates and sizes within 0.1 point.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token. Native aspect-ratio behavior is preserved; inspect all dimensions afterwards.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

deleteShape.purpose: Delete one top-level shape by its observed ID.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

deleteShape.verification: Confirm the shape ID is absent.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token; deletion removes all content of the specified shape.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

save.purpose: Save the bound existing presentation to its authorized backing file.
save.verification: Verify saved state, nonempty .pptx artifact and continuous exact binding.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use saveAs for first save or a new path. Retain locator and all file-identity fences through native replacement.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

getShapeStyle.purpose: Read shape appearance, text box layout and individual paragraph properties.
getShapeStyle.verification: Inspect actual fill, border, margins and paragraph values; null means mixed or unavailable.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: At most 100 paragraphs; token covers this shape summary, appearance, frame and paragraph fields.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

formatShape.purpose: Apply a solid fill, transparency and border patch.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getShapeStyle for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

fillColor.description: Encode RGB channels (0-255) as R + G*256 + B*65536 (0xBBGGRR). Example: #1F3864 = 6567967; red #FF0000 = 255. Do not use the ordinary 0xRRGGBB integer.

lineColor.description: Encode RGB channels (0-255) as R + G*256 + B*65536 (0xBBGGRR). Example: #1F3864 = 6567967; red #FF0000 = 255. Do not use the ordinary 0xRRGGBB integer.

formatShape.verification: Compare every requested appearance property; explicit fillColor must produce solid fill.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getShapeStyle token; colors are OLE RGB integers. Setting fillColor replaces a gradient or picture fill. Fill color/transparency enables fill; lineColor enables the border. Do not combine these with explicit hidden visibility.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

formatParagraph.purpose: Set uniform paragraph alignment, spacing in points and bullet visibility.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getShapeStyle for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

formatParagraph.verification: Verify every paragraph matches each requested property.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getShapeStyle token; applies to all paragraphs. Only bullet visibility is changed; WPS chooses the native bullet style when enabling bullets.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

setTextBoxLayout.purpose: Set margins, word wrap and vertical text alignment.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getShapeStyle for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

setTextBoxLayout.verification: Compare requested margins within 0.1 point and exact wrapping/alignment.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getShapeStyle token. Native AutoSize and shape geometry behavior are preserved; inspect shape dimensions afterwards.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

renameShape.purpose: Rename one top-level shape without changing its ID.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

renameShape.verification: Verify exact shape name and stable ID.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token; names never become document or shape execution addresses.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

setShapeOrder.purpose: Bring a shape to front or send it to back.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

setShapeOrder.verification: Verify zOrder equals the shape count for front, or 1 for back.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token; top-level stacking order only.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

alignShapes.purpose: Align selected shape bounds within their collective bounding box.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

alignShapes.verification: Verify requested edges or centers agree within 0.1 point.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token. 2–20 unrotated top-level shapes; no UI selection, slide-relative alignment or size changes.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

distributeShapes.purpose: Distribute unrotated shapes with equal horizontal or vertical gaps.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

distributeShapes.verification: Verify equal edge-to-edge gaps within 0.2 point and unchanged outer bounds.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token. 3–20 unrotated top-level shapes, with nonnegative available gaps; outer shapes stay fixed.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

getSlideSettings.purpose: Read slide name, slideshow visibility and background settings.
getSlideSettings.verification: Inspect hidden state, background inheritance, fill type and color.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Token covers only returned slide setting fields.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

setSlideSettings.purpose: Rename a slide, hide it in slideshow or set its background.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideSettings for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

backgroundColor.description: Encode RGB channels (0-255) as R + G*256 + B*65536 (0xBBGGRR). Example: #1F3864 = 6567967; red #FF0000 = 255. Do not use the ordinary 0xRRGGBB integer.

setSlideSettings.verification: Compare all requested settings; explicit background color disables master inheritance and sets solid fill.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideSettings token. Hiding affects slideshow inclusion, not editing visibility.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

getSlideNotes.purpose: Read the slide notes body placeholder.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Exactly one body placeholder is required. At most 10000 UTF-16 units; no date/footer/slide-image placeholders.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

setSlideNotes.purpose: Replace the complete notes body text.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideNotes for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideNotes token. Full replacement can reset notes rich formatting; other notes placeholders are untouched.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

findText.purpose: Find literal case-sensitive text in a slide’s top-level text shapes.
findText.verification: Inspect matched shape IDs and zero-based UTF-16 offsets; results never address a document.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: At most 100 nonoverlapping matches. No regex, groups, tables, notes or cross-slide search; token is the getSlideInfo observation.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

replaceText.purpose: Replace every literal case-sensitive occurrence in one shape.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

replaceText.verification: Compare complete expected text and replacement count after native text-range edits.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token. At most 100 nonoverlapping matches; edits run from end to start, preserving text outside replaced spans. Result text must fit 10000 UTF-16 units.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

addImage.purpose: Embed one existing PNG or JPEG at explicit slide coordinates.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

addImage.verification: Verify exactly one new picture shape and requested dimensions; image bytes must be embedded on save.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token. Absolute existing host path, at most 20 MiB and 40 million pixels; embedded, never linked. Explicit dimensions may change aspect ratio.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

addTable.purpose: Insert a native table containing a rectangular literal-text matrix.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest getSlideInfo for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

addTable.verification: Read each native cell and compare the complete matrix and dimensions.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use getSlideInfo token. At most 20 rows, 10 columns, 100 cells and 20000 total UTF-16 units. Literal text only.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

readTable.purpose: Read all literal cell text from one top-level native table.
readTable.verification: Check row/column counts and all cell text.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Same table bounds as addTable; token covers table ID, dimensions and cell text, not styling or merged-cell geometry.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

writeTable.purpose: Replace all cell text of one existing table without resizing.

expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest readTable for the same target; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

writeTable.verification: Compare every cell with the complete requested matrix.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Use readTable token. Matrix must exactly match existing rows/columns. Cell rich formatting may reset; merged cells may reject or yield an uncertain partial result, never auto-retry.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

createPresentation.purpose: Create one blank unsaved document; no file path.
createPresentation.verification: Verify exact binding, artifact format and unchanged observed content/state.
prerequisites: Explicit existing-file or new-document intent; UNBOUND Task.
constraints: No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

saveAs.purpose: First-save or save the same live document to an absent destination.
saveAs.verification: Verify exact binding, artifact format and unchanged observed content/state.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: At most 200 slides and 100 top-level shapes per slide. Never replaces a preexisting destination. Retain old and new locator and identity fences until Task cleanup.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

exportPdf.purpose: Export to an absent destination without saving the document.
exportPdf.verification: Verify exact binding, artifact format and unchanged observed content/state.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Native PDF export defaults; PNG uses explicit pixels. At most 200 slides and 100 top-level shapes per slide. Verify exported format and unchanged bounded observations; no save or retargeting.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.

exportSlideImage.purpose: Export one slide image to an absent destination without saving the presentation.
exportSlideImage.verification: Verify exact binding, artifact format and unchanged observed content/state.
prerequisites: One exact live Presentation is bound to this PPT Task.
constraints: Native PDF export defaults; PNG uses explicit pixels. At most 200 slides and 100 top-level shapes per slide. Verify exported format and unchanged bounded observations; no save or retargeting.
No active-document or selection targeting. No implicit save or automatic replay.
